caseName: Whittemore v. Circuit Court of Kenosha County
caseNameFull: Whittemore v. Circuit Court of Kenosha County
judges: Appeal, Certiorari, Dismiss, Jurisdiction, Taken, Treat, Want, Whereon, Writ

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Wis. dismissed for want of jurisdiction.

Justice Blackmun would dismiss the appeal for want of jurisdiction, treat the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, and deny certiorari.
